english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a main public road or highway.
Use this specifically for a public road or highway, including a numbered highway route.

examples.english: I drive along this highway to work every morning.
examples.traditional: 我朝早揸車行呢條公路返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zaa1 ce1 haang4 ni1 tiu4 gung1 lou6 faan1 gung1

examples.english: We take this highway route to the airport.
examples.traditional: 我哋揸車經呢條公路去機場。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zaa1 ce1 ging1 ni1 tiu4 gung1 lou6 heoi3 gei1 coeng4
